items.title: Scene at MIT: Artfinity brings artistic celebration to campus
items.blurb: The MIT campus came alive with artistic energy on March 13 as Artfinity — the Institute's new festival celebrating creativity and community — took over multiple venues with interactive experiences, exhibitions, and performances.

items.title: Spreading joy with Wide Tim
items.blurb: MIT senior Margaret Zheng created Wide Tim to help connect the MIT community with an adorable character inspired by MIT's mascot, Tim the Beaver.

items.title: The 2023 Wiesner Student Art Awards
items.blurb: Each year, the Laya and Jerome B. Wiesner Student Art Award is presented to four honorees for exceptional artistic contributions to the Institute community.

items.title: The beaver with the infinite smile
items.blurb: Despite a busy schedule packed with eating and sleeping, Wide Tim makes time for the vital work of spreading happiness.
